title: Studio Provider
description:
Unified single-file provider definition. Replaces the legacy manifest.json + provider.json + adapter-config.json triplet.

Stability: future versions of this schema must remain backward-compatible with content authored against earlier versions of itself — once a package is published with a given version, it must continue to validate against the schema in force at install time. Add fields conservatively (optional first); promote to required only with a major schema revision and a migration story.

slug.description: Stable identifier used as the provider key. Must match the file basename.

name.description: Human-readable provider name shown in the UI.

description.description: Short description of what the provider does.

provider_type.description: Backend type: API for HTTP providers, INTERNAL for built-in flow utilities, LOCAL_WORKER for jobs that run on a dedicated worker.

category.description: Primary category for grouping in the UI.

icon_url.description: Path or URL to the provider icon.

documentation_url.description: External documentation URL for the provider's API.

base_url.description: Base URL for API providers. Null for INTERNAL providers.

credential_provider.description: Slug of another provider whose credentials this provider reuses (e.g. Google services share OAuth).

requires.description: Other provider slugs this provider depends on.

services_preview.description: Short list of service names shown in the marketplace card.

credential_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the credential fields users must provide. Null for providers that need no auth.

config.description: Type-specific config. For oauth2: must include oauth_provider (the credential provider slug) and optionally token_field.

oauth_provider.description: Slug of the OAuth provider (e.g. google, facebook, tiktok).

token_field.description: Key in secret_data that holds the access token (default: access_token).

default_headers.description: Default headers to include on every outbound request from this provider.

oauth.description: OAuth2 runtime config stored in provider.config.oauth and read by the OAuth flow at runtime.

default_queue.description: Default job queue services without an explicit queue override are dispatched to.

local_worker.description: Local-worker dispatch config. Set on providers whose jobs run on a dedicated GPU/audio/video worker rather than the generic step worker.

field_type_mapping.description: Maps provider-specific field type names to generic UI field types. Used by the table-schema endpoint to render external schemas (e.g. Airtable) in a unified form.

webhook_completion.description: Provider-level inbound-callback ENVELOPE contract. The callback payload shape is a property of the provider's webhook API, not the service - every service shares one envelope; per-service differences (the create-response wrapper, the asset shape) live in the SERVICE-level webhook_completion. Required at the provider level when any service declares completion_modes including 'webhook'. The generic inbound handler resolves these JSONPaths against the provider callback and imports no provider.

id_callback_path.description: JSONPath to the generation/job id in the inbound callback (the match key against the parked iteration's external_id).

status_callback_path.description: JSONPath to the terminal status in the callback.

failure_values.description: Status values that mean failure. Optional - absence means any non-success terminal status is a failure.

type.description: bearer_header = validate Authorization: Bearer against credential_field; url_token = the opaque callback_token in the URL is the only gate (e.g. json2video, which sends no auth header); none = no inbound auth.

credential_field.description: Credential-blob key holding the inbound secret (required for bearer_header).

services.description: Map of service slug to service definition.

service_type.description: Service category (CORE, AI, AUTOMATION, COMMUNICATION, etc.).

requires_credentials.description: Defaults to true at install time when omitted.

custom_ui.description: Render a custom editor instead of the generic parameter form. Defaults to false.

custom_output.description: Service manages its own output; the UI hides the output schema section. Defaults to false.

parameter_title.description: Custom parameter-section title; the UI falls back to 'Service Parameters' when null.

path.description: URL path appended to the provider's base_url (was 'endpoint' in legacy adapter-config). Null for internal/local-worker services with no API endpoint.

endpoint_url.description: Per-service full URL override. Used when a single service hits a different host than the provider's base_url (e.g. Google Sheets services that hit sheets.googleapis.com instead of the OAuth root).

endpoint_template.description: Per-service URL template with {{ }} placeholders (used by adapters that build URLs from parameters).

queue.description: Per-service queue override. Falls back to provider-level default_queue when omitted.

status.description: Per-service active/inactive flag (used by inactive providers to mark legacy services).

dispatch.description: Worker-side handler selectors. Currently 'http_request' routes through the generic outbound-HTTP handler. Replaces the legacy 'hooks' field.

parameter_mapping.description: Maps user-facing parameter names to wire locations (body, query_params, headers, path_params). Replaces the legacy camelCase 'parameterMapping'.

polling.description: Adapter-driven polling config (status URL, completion path, interval).

completion_modes.description: Completion modes this service supports. 'get' = synchronous polling (default when omitted). 'webhook' = fire-and-release, complete on a provider callback. A service declaring 'webhook' MUST also declare a webhook_completion block (enforced at install time and at commit time).

webhook_completion.description: Service-level webhook-completion config: the parsing tied to THIS specific endpoint. The inbound callback ENVELOPE (id_callback_path, status_callback_path, success/failure values, auth) is provider-level (see the top-level webhook_completion). Required when completion_modes includes 'webhook'.

id_response_path.description: JSONPath to the generation/job id in THIS endpoint's submit response (endpoint-specific wrapper, e.g. $.sdGenerationJob.generationId).

result_callback_path.description: JSONPath to the asset URL(s) inside the callback envelope (the asset shape differs per service - image vs. video vs. audio).

local_worker.description: Per-service local-worker override (rare — most providers set this at the top level).

request_body_template.description: Legacy alias for request_transform.body. Kept for backwards compat; prefer request_transform.

response_type.description: Hint to the response handler about the expected payload type (e.g. 'binary' for audio downloads vs 'json' for JSON-encoded results).

orchestrator_hints.description: API enqueue hints (inline, pauses, wait_for, pause_status, polling, stops_workflow).

prompt_shape.description: Opts the service into prompt dispatch shaping. 'chat' parses the neutral messages list ([{role, content}]) into the dialect's wire shape at enqueue.

wire_dialect.description: Wire format the service speaks. The dispatch shaper branches on this key only - never on provider name - so any provider speaking an existing dialect is pure config.

array_mapping_notice.description: Human-readable note shown in the UI when a list parameter is sent as one combined request rather than iterated (read by WorkflowStepConfig.tsx).
